instructions: Put the 1/3 cup misutgaru in a large jar or pitcher.
Pour in 1/2 cup of the milk and stir until it forms a smooth paste with no lumps.
Pour in the remaining 3 1/2 cups milk and stir well, or put the lid on the jar and shake it.
Divide it among 4 glasses and add an ice cube to each. Serve cold.
method_notes: Cup of Yum (4.5 from 8) blends 2 Tbsp of misugaru with 1 1/2 cups of milk, honey and a little ice, and Honest Food Talks makes a paste with a little milk first so it doesn't clump, then adds the rest. Spoon University uses much less powder, 1 Tbsp to 2/3 cup of milk. This follows Cup of Yum's ratio for 4 cups of milk and Honest Food Talks' paste method. All three pages have fewer than 20 ratings, so this is a fallback lead. Some misutgaru blends contain peanuts or other nuts, so check the label before buying.
